A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TAAT/HumanML3D++ study. Their complete text, equations, seven tables, eight figures and references support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v5 reports original motion-generation experiments, human evaluations, prompt ablations and index-length sensitivity results in Section 6, Tables 3–7 and Figure 8.

after.justification: v6 retains the original motion-generation experiments, human evaluations and ablation results in Section 6, Tables 3–7 and Figure 8.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same LoRA-finetuned Think model, VQ-VAE representation and autoregressive Act procedure using indices from the preceding action. No method component or training objective changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use HumanML3D and HumanML3D++ for the same action-text, scene-text and zero-shot evaluations. Dataset construction and represented test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 3–4 retain TM2T, MDM, MLD, MotionDiffuse and T2M-GPT in the corresponding comparisons. Table 6 likewise retains GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, Llama-3-8B and Gemini.

E3.justification: The metrics, training budgets, model configurations, validation allocation and zero-shot design are unchanged. Section 6.5 retains the same evaluation of 100 scene texts by 23 assessors.

E4.justification: Section 6.5 retains the filtering, LLM-choice, prompt-component and index-length studies. The cross-task FID analysis in Table 5 and qualitative cases in Figures 5–7 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Tables 2–4 retain the same plus/minus reporting practice. No run or seed information, uncertainty estimation procedure or significance test is added or revised.

E6.justification: All table entries and figure findings are unchanged. For example, trained TAAT retains Hit Accuracy 79.9, FID 0.379 ± 0.014 and Mean Hit Distance 1.075 in Table 3.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9 retain the same objectives, motion-generation recurrence and definitions of Hit Accuracy and Mean Hit Distance. No mathematical reasoning or proof is added, removed or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims concerning Arbitrary Text to Motion, HumanML3D++, TAAT and multi-solution evaluation, without changing their scope.

C2.justification: The explanations of scene understanding, generalization, filtering benefits and index-length trade-offs are unchanged. The qualifications concerning baselines' dependence on ground-truth motion lengths are also retained.

D1.justification: Sections 3 and 6.1 retain identical data-construction, validation and implementation details, including training hyperparameters. Both abstracts still promise future release of the data, model and code.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 50 works and retain the same research positioning in Section 2. Reference back-link changes only reflect pagination.

P1.justification: The author block replaces uniform Wuhan University affiliations with specific institutional affiliations and adds equal-contribution and correspondence details. Scientific prose, terminology and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Front-matter formatting and page reflow change placement: Table 2 switches columns, Table 4 moves from page 7 to page 8, and the final reference moves to page 11. Figure images, table structures and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v6 clarifies author affiliations, contribution credit and contact information, while retaining the complete scientific content and evidence. These administrative edits and modest layout shifts do not meaningfully change the paper's overall clarity, evidential support or reproducibility.
